children.name: Opisthoteuthis
children.description: Opisthoteuthis — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis agassizii A.E.Verrill, 1883
children.description: Opisthoteuthis agassizii is a lesser-known, deep-sea octopus first described in 1883 by Addison E.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis albatrossi
children.description: Opisthoteuthis albatrossi is a cirrate octopus originally found off Kinkasan in Japan. This species was described from only four specimens. It is similar to Opisthoteuthis californiana; the two may be the same species.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis borealis Collins, 2005
children.description: Opisthoteuthis borealis is a lesser-known species of octopus found near Greenland and Iceland,.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis bruuni
children.description: Opisthoteuthis bruuni is a species of finned cirrate octopus found along the western coast of the Americas from Chile to as far north as California. Their tissue is almost jelly-like, and they have short, round bodies. The octopus was named for Anton Bruun, a Danish ichthyologist.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis californiana S.S.Berry, 1949
children.description: Opisthoteuthis californiana, also known as the flapjack octopus or flapjack devilfish, is a species of umbrella octopus.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis calypso Villanueva, Collins, P.Sánchez & N.A.Voss, 2002
Opisthoteuthis chathamensis O'Shea, 1999
children.description: Opisthoteuthis chathamensis, commonly known as the roughy umbrella octopus, is a species of cirrate octopus found in demersal habitats surrounding the Chatham Rise in New Zealand and Macquarie Island (Australian Antarctic Territories) .

children.name: Opisthoteuthis dongshaensis C.C.Lu, 2010
children.description: Opisthoteuthis dongshaensis is a species of octopus located in the South China Sea.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis extensa Thiele, 1915
children.description: Insigniteuthis extensa (formerly allocated to genus Opisthoteuthis) is a species of flapjack octopus from waters off Indonesia and north-western Australia.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis grimaldii
children.description: Opisthoteuthis grimaldii is an octopus found near the Azores.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis hardyi Villanueva, Collins, P.Sánchez & N.A.Voss, 2002
children.description: Opisthoteuthis hardyi is a lesser-known octopus species.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis japonica Taki, 1962
children.description: Opisthoteuthis japonica is a species of octopus that lives in the Pacific Ocean near Japan.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis massyae
children.description: Opisthoteuthis massyae is an octopus living in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis medusoides Thiele, 1915
children.description: Opisthoteuthis medusoides is a cirrate octopus living off the coast of Tanzania near Dar es Salaam.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis mero O'Shea, 1999
children.description: Opisthoteuthis mero, commonly known as Mero's umbrella octopus, is a species of cirrate octopus from demersal habitats surrounding New Zealand.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis persephone S.S.Berry, 1918
children.description: Opisthoteuthis (Exsuperoteuthis) persephone is a cirrate octopus found off southern Australia.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis philipii Oommen, 1976
children.description: Opisthoteuthis philipii is an octopus of the Indian Ocean.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis pluto S.S.Berry, 1918
children.description: Opisthoteuthis pluto is a deep-sea cirrate octopus found off southern Australia in the bathyal zone.

children.name: Opisthoteuthis robsoni O'Shea, 1999
children.description: Opisthoteuthis robsoni, also known as the deep-water umbrella octopus, is a deep-sea octopus living off New Zealand on the Chatham Rise.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis
children.description: Grimpoteuthis — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis abyssicola O'Shea, 1999
children.description: Grimpoteuthis abyssicola, commonly known as the red jellyhead, is a species of small deep-sea octopus known from two specimens.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis angularis Verhoeff & O'Shea, 2022
children.description: Grimpoteuthis angularis is a species of octopus in the family Grimpoteuthidae.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis bathynectes G.L.Voss & Pearcy, 1990
children.description: Grimpoteuthis bathynectes is a deepwater species of Grimpoteuthis (Dumbo) octopus first described in 1990.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis boylei Collins, 2003
children.description: Grimpoteuthis boylei is a species of octopus known from only ten individuals.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis challengeri Collins, 2003
children.description: Grimpoteuthis challengeri is a species of large octopus living in the abyssal zone.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis discoveryi Collins, 2003
children.description: Grimpoteuthis discoveryi is a small species of octopus known from more than 50 specimens.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis hippocrepium
children.description: Grimpoteuthis hippocrepium is a species of octopus. It is only known from one specimen found in 1904, which was poorly preserved. Some characteristics of G.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis innominata
children.description: Grimpoteuthis innominata, commonly known as the small jellyhead, is a species of small, pelagic octopus described by Steve O'Shea in 1999 from two specimens, however several further specimens have since been identified. The genus Enigmateuthis was described to contain this species when described, but Martin Collins placed the species in the genus Grimpoteuthis due to uncertainty regarding the type specimen of Grimpoteuthis.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis meangensis
children.description: Grimpoteuthis meangensis is known from either one or two specimens, though the second may be of a completely different species. The first was damaged. Both were found by William Evans Hoyle within one year of each other, and no other animals of the species have been identified since 1886.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis megaptera
children.description: Grimpoteuthis megaptera is a species of octopus known from five specimens, collected by Addison Emery Verrill. Between two and three of these specimens may belong to different species.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis pacifica
children.description: Grimpoteuthis pacifica is an octopus known from one badly damaged specimen. It is not completely described, and it is not easily separated from some other species of octopus. Nothing clearly differentiates G.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis plena
children.description: Grimpoteuthis plena is known from only one specimen, which cannot be easily separated from other species of Grimpoteuthis in the Atlantic Ocean. This species may be a senior synonym to Grimpoteuthis wuelkeri, but the poor condition of the only known specimen hinders comparison. Grimpoteuthis plena, along with G.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis tuftsi G.L.Voss & Pearcy, 1990
children.description: Grimpoteuthis tuftsi is an octopus known from seven specimens.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis umbellata
children.description: Grimpoteuthis umbellata, is known from three specimens and is the type species of Grimpoteuthis. The three original specimens were collected during 1883 by the French research vessel Le Talisman, on one of the first deep-sea voyages conducted by France, and described by malacologist Paul Henri Fischer.

children.name: Grimpoteuthis wuelkeri
children.description: Grimpoteuthis wuelkeri is a medium-sized octopus characterized from multiple specimens.

children.name: Luteuthis
children.description: Luteuthis — a genus of cephalopods.

children.name: Luteuthis dentatus O'Shea, 1999
children.description: Luteuthis dentatus, also known as Lu's jellyhead, is a medium-sized species of cirrate octopus found in the southwestern Pacific, originally described by Steve O'Shea.

children.name: Luteuthis shuishi O'Shea & Lu, 2002
children.description: Luteuthis shuishi is a species of octopus that lives in the South China Sea, which is known only from one female specimen collected at a depth of 767 meters.

children.name: Cryptoteuthis
children.description: Cryptoteuthis — a genus of cephalopods.
